title: McDonald's
description:
Contact us via Tox within 24 hours or your data will be available for download. 293 GB across 605,230 files from McDonald's AWS S3 buckets (109+ accounts, 86 GB), 28 GitHub organizations' source code, 190 Confluence spaces, and 1,096 Jira projects. Customer data includes 781,014 US customer master records, of which 110,663 are individually verified records containing names, emails (100%), loyalty IDs (81.5%), phone numbers (50.5%), and dates of birth (30.9%); full payment-card metadata (last-4 digits, card type, expiry, billing ZIP) is present for 39,292 customers, plus 31,970 PAN tokens and 2,694 prepaid/gift cards. Harvested across all text files totals 938,667 unique emails (~370,000 McDonald's staff), 446,284 phone numbers, and 26,540 dates of birth.
Status: warning
Deadline: 2026-11-27
